svg.title: Independent validation at preparation commitment publication and terminal boundaries
svg.desc: Four boundaries link pinned identities and prepared IDs, committed generated IDs and model prefix evidence, stable visible text, and terminal bytes reasons counts and delivery. Final text equality is insufficient to validate all previous stages.
svg.text: Validate meaning at every representation boundary
Manifest + messages → template / encoder → prepared IDs
Fixture I: [0, 1, 4, 5, 6, 2, 3]; P = 7; exact mask and positions.
Selection → committed ID history + prefix / logit evidence
Same final text can hide wrong preparation or wrong later logits.
Stateful decode / stop → stable visible prefixes
No delimiter leakage, invalid UTF-8 or silent text retraction.
Final bytes + reason + counts + delivery evidence
Empty text does not identify EOS, length, stop or error.
Each boundary needs its own reference; later equality cannot prove earlier equality.
